idea-plugin.name: Window Tabs
idea-plugin.description:
Every open project becomes a tab at the top of each IDE window, like the native window tabs JetBrains IDEs offer on macOS. Built for Linux, where that feature does not exist.

  • Click a tab to switch: that project's window takes the current window's size and position (or stays maximized) and comes to the front.
  • Middle-click, or the × shown on hover, closes the project.
  • + opens another project.
  • While the IDE reopens the last session, projects still loading show as dimmed tabs.
  • The strip appears only while two or more projects are open.

Each project stays in its own window, so the IDE handles projects exactly as before. Works in every JetBrains IDE 2026.1 or newer.

GNOME on Wayland: if GNOME shows a "ready" notice instead of raising the window, run the IDE on X11: Help → Edit Custom VM Options → -Dawt.toolkit.name=XToolkit.
